name: QMI8658 Temperature Sensor
description: The `qmi8658` sensor platform provides access to the temperature sensor in a QMI8658 Accelerometer/Gyroscope with ESPHome. It requires a [`motion`](https://esphome.io/components/motion) component to be configured with the `qmi8658` platform, which handles the accelerometer and gyroscope data processing and configures the device. See that component for more information.

config_entries.label: Address
config_entries.description: Manually specify the I²C address of the sensor. Defaults to 0x6B. The QMI8658 supports 0x6B (SA0 high) and 0x6A (SA0 low).

config_entries.label: Accelerometer Odr
config_entries.description: The output data rate of the accelerometer. One of 31_25HZ, 62_5HZ, 125HZ, 250HZ, 500HZ, 1000HZ, 2000HZ, 4000HZ, 8000HZ. Defaults to 1000HZ.

config_entries.label: Accelerometer Range
config_entries.description: The full-scale range of the accelerometer. One of 2G, 4G, 8G, 16G. Defaults to 4G.

config_entries.label: Gyroscope Odr
config_entries.description: The output data rate of the gyroscope. One of 31_25HZ, 62_5HZ, 125HZ, 250HZ, 500HZ, 1000HZ, 2000HZ, 4000HZ, 8000HZ. Defaults to 1000HZ.

config_entries.label: Gyroscope Range
config_entries.description: The full-scale range of the gyroscope. One of 16DPS, 32DPS, 64DPS, 128DPS, 256DPS, 512DPS, 1024DPS, 2048DPS. Defaults to 2048DPS.
